r_01KX9NG926F81SBNQV5HMS8SBY.subject: notes_field_purpose
r_01KX9NG926F81SBNQV5HMS8SBY.content: The notes field on an app_project must carry live scope-relevant PM notes only; QA or test data must be cleared before the project advances to estimation or crew scheduling.
r_01KX9NG926F81SBNQV5HMS8SBY.notes: Promoted from proposal pr_01KX9MFEE3AKC18S5R88H9CN4R (proposed 2026-07-11T22:23:57.323Z). Rationale: the owner confirmed this is the intended purpose of the notes field going forward, to avoid confusing downstream workflows with test artifacts.
